title: Test registration and no-existing-test weakening
statement: The five C++ suites must be registered as CMake/CTest targets under the shared src/xverse/xcom/CMakeLists.txt with T020-specific labels and discovered/executed by the deterministic gate; the Python module must be discovered by pytest; and neither the T017/T018 Python suites nor the T019 decoder suites may be edited or weakened.
applicability: src/xverse/xcom/CMakeLists.txt (shared) and the T020 pytest module discovery
verification_intent: CTest discovery of the t020 label and pytest collection; trusted unit, integration, and validation measures.
acceptance_criteria: ctest discovers the T020 suites and runs them together with the existing suites.
pytest collects and passes the T020 module.
git diff shows no edit to an existing test.
